notes: Swim anywhere: walk into the sea and you swim at the surface; you can always climb back onto a beach or a pier. No more getting stuck between the water and a slope
Menu → Unstuck takes you to the nearest checkpoint; if you push against something for a few seconds the game offers it too
Travelling with the map's Travel button keeps you in Veyra (it used to drop you to the menu)
Mountains: the foothills are walkable; you only slip on the really steep, high faces
Poké Ball: a simple tap anywhere throws (no need to hold)
Pokémon always appear as Pokémon, never as flat cards from far away
Mistvale's Great Tree is dressed for Christmas: baubles hanging on the leaves, a garland of lights and a star
New Pokédex (Cards → Pokédex): every species you can meet, seen and caught, with coin rewards at 10/25/50/100/200/400 caught
After the story: the Rift League (four Elites around Relay Node 7) and the Hall of Fame, stronger Warden rematches, rare legends roaming
Daily festivals: each day one town celebrates (Wind Festival, Star Festival, Ice Gala…) with more of its Echoes and a Festival Host whose battle wins you clothes
Sound: every character has a voice while talking, footsteps change with the ground (grass, sand, snow, wood, stone, water), each type has its own cry
Your save: automatic backups on the device and a save code you can copy and paste to move your progress (Trainer → Settings)
Townsfolk and trainers have sturdier arms and legs
